title: Shinichi Kudo's New York Case
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Shinichi/Conan, Ran) omitted by convention; Yukiko and Yusaku Kudo are kept because they are specific active participants in this story (Yukiko performs the on-stage 'Night Baroness' deduction reveal; Yusaku is the reason Radish Redwood appears at all) rather than generic case-solving apparatus. Episode 287's subtitle file is missing locally -- only 0286 and 0288 were read, so the middle episode's on-screen detail (likely more of the backstage tour / early investigation) is not represented here; everything included is grounded in what actually appears in 0286 and 0288. The old cases/ file's culprit call (Rose Hewitt) matches the transcript -- no correction needed there. It did, however: (1) mislabel the venue as 'Majestic Theatre' -- the transcript only ever calls it the 'Phantom Theater' on Broadway; (2) romanize the fourth actress as 'Iberis Hamilton' where the on-screen character card reads 'Everith Hamilton' (kept as the primary name, old spelling recorded as an alias); (3) omit an entire second, unresolved plot thread that runs through both episodes: a serial killer targeting young Japanese girls turns up dead of an apparent self-inflicted gunshot, but Shinichi later notices the blood and fingerprints at the scene were wiped clean -- meaning someone silenced him before police arrived. The transcript never names that second killer, so no murderer_id is assigned for it; it is captured only as attrs on the serial killer's own person node and flagged unresolved here rather than invented. case_type: murder.
